# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation and engine updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 packages compiler-generated XML documentation alongside the updated Skia renderer. API documentation now travels with the managed packages, while the bundled renderer incorporates current upstream Chrome fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Chrome m154 fixes integrated** — Updates the bundled Skia renderer with upstream Chrome m154 fixes for improved rendering correctness. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships with packages** — Compiler-generated XML documentation is authored with the C# API and included beside the managed assemblies, improving IntelliSense and package-consumer documentation. ([#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066))
